p.s: To: American students group leader
From: ...
Re: Information on an interesting building to visit
Introduction
Here is my report for American students who want information on an interesting building to visit in Ankara.
I would like to describe 'Anitkabir'
Findings
1. This building's name is 'Anitkabir' and it is the biggest building in Ankara.
It built in 1953.
It is placed in the middle of the forest.
There is different kind of bird and different kind of trees present.
2. It has very big museum inside the building and all building made from stone.
3. This building's security guards are very special soldiers.
Their aim is to protect the building from the enemies because there is also very big army museum available.
4. It has no charge for entrance and it has a good view for tourists to seeing Ankara from the hill.
It opens at 8.00 am to 5.00 pm
Recommendations
I recommend that it is the best building in Ankara to visit because it includes all Turkish history and very good sight seeing.
